newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Market waiting for direction from fed trade. Beef prices up but trade slow.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Higher CME index and easier corn futures call.
HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Steady to lower cash hog calls on increased runs. Higher pork cutouts may limit loss.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Technically weak and hog slaughter seen up. Out-of-town after close.
